question: A hockey ground is rectangular in shape, measuring 91.4 m in length and ______ in width.
solution:
The correct answer is __**55 m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The standard dimensions of a hockey field, as specified by the **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**, are 91.4 meters in length and **55 meters in width**.
 
• The field is rectangular in shape and surrounded by boundary lines known as the **sidelines** (length) and the **backlines** (width).
 
• The playing area also includes a **23-meter line** from each backline and a **shooting circle** around the goalposts, which are crucial for gameplay regulations.
 
• These dimensions are used consistently across all international matches and tournaments to ensure uniformity in the playing conditions.
 
• The turf can be natural grass, sand-based artificial turf, or water-based artificial turf, but most international matches are played on water-based artificial surfaces for better ball control and speed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**

 
 
• The **FIH** is the global governing body for field hockey and indoor hockey.
 
• It was established in 1924 and sets the rules and regulations for the sport, including field dimensions.
 
• Its headquarters are located in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
 
 
• **Shooting Circle**
 
 
• This is a **16-yard semicircular area** marked around each goalpost.
 
• A goal is only counted if the ball is hit within this area.
 
 
 
• **Artificial Turf**
 
 
• Modern hockey matches, especially at the international level, are played on **artificial turf**.
 
• Water-based turfs are preferred as they provide better traction, speed, and ball control.
 
 
 
• **Penalty Corner and Penalty Stroke**
 
 
• A penalty corner is awarded for certain fouls committed inside the defensive 23-meter area or circle.
 
• A penalty stroke is awarded for more serious infringements within the shooting circle.
